## Features

## Information
These classically shaped artificial boxwood spiral trees are extremely lifelike and realistic looking. From a short distance it's hard to believe they are not real. Perfect if you don't want the hassle or have the time to care for living plants. Easy and maintenance free so no need to water or prune. The trees simply look perfect all year round. The trees look absolutely fantastic either side of entrances, doorways, on the balcony, outside shop fronts, offices and receptions as well as bars & restaurants. For an extra stylish look, plant the trees up into large planters or tubs. Fill the bottom with a heavy material such as sand or stones to prevent the tree from being blown over in strong winds. Then fill with a material that can be compacted such as ordinary soil up to the level you want the tree to sit in the planter. Place the tree in the middle and fill to the top and compact hard around the plastic pot and the base of the tree. The tree has a strong solid wood centre, making it robust and durable. They are supplied in a plastic pot with concrete filling to stabilize the base of the tree. Please note the trees are packed in cardboard cartons for maximum protection. The trees are lying down flat in the boxes which can cause the plastic foliage to be compressed and a little out of shape. The perfect shape can be regained by gently pulling and fluffing the foliage back into shape. These trees are sold as a pair (2 trees per carton).

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Premium quality, exceptionally lifelike and realistic.
- UV protected, suitable for both indoor & outdoor use.
- Sold as a pair (set of 2). Height: 90cm/3ft.
- Look stunning planted up into large tubs placed either side of front doors or entrances.
- Maintenance free

## Information
A pair of premium quality, highly desirable artificial spiral boxwood topiary trees measuring 90cm/3ft in height. Extremely lifelike and realistic looking, from a short distance it's hard to believe they are not real. Easy and carefree alternative to real plants. Perfect if you don't want the hassle or have the time to care for living plants. They look absolutely fantastic either side of doorways, on the balcony or patio. Also outside shop fronts, offices and receptions as well as bars & restaurants. For an extra stylish look, plant the trees up into large planters or tubs. Fill the bottom with a heavy material such as sand or stones to prevent the tree being blown over in strong winds. Then fill with a material that can be compacted such as ordinary soil up to the level you want the tree to sit in the planter. Place the tree in the middle and fill to the top and compact hard around the plastic pot and the base of the tree. The core is a metal pole which the plastic foliage spirals around. The metal core is not visible as the foliage is thick and covers the pole entirely. The metal core provides a strong solid centre for the tree, making it robust and durable. Supplied in a black plastic pot with concrete filling to stabilize the base of the tree. The pot can be removed simply by pulling out the metal centre from its housing in the pot. Please note the trees are packed in cardboard cartons for maximum protection. The trees are lying down flat in the boxes which can cause the plastic foliage to be compressed and out of shape. The perfect shape can be regained by gently pulling and fluffing the foliage back into shape. Sold as a pair (2 trees per carton).

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- High-quality ceramic, Porcelain
- Perfect for flowers or decorative display
- elegant modern jar

## Information
FLOWERVASE: The classic conic flower vase is timeless and suits any interior design. The design is elegant, sleek and very suitable for a full bouquet. This artisan mouthblown vase is made with heavier glass, so will feel and look very luxurious. MOUTH BLOWN GLASS: DutZ vases are unique! Each glass vessel or glass object is made by hand from mouth blown glass. Every item is carefully crafted in the most traditional way by our master glassblowers from our European glass studios. This ancient craft has hardly changed throughout the ages. UNIQUELY CRAFTED: Each DutZ Collection vase, bowl, pot, or art object is therefore slightly different in colouring, shape and dimensions. Small deviations such as air bubbles, scratches, colour saturation are not defects, but a result of the process of traditional glass blowing. They enrich the product and give it a unique appearance. All DutZ vessels and objects are made from rich, heavy, luxurious glass; Usually it is 3 mm thick. The colouring is mixed inside the glass and not painted on. No DutZ vessel is ever exactly alike. And we like it that way! STYLISH: The DutZ Collection is a carefully curated range of ever-changing colours, shapes and designs. The colourful DutZ glass designs are trendsetting: from award-winning limited editions by glass artists, to small clear glass candle votives. The popularity of DutZ glass has been growing rapidly in the last 10 years. DutZ is one of the biggest names of original mouth blown glass items and glass design in Europe, the brand follows the footsteps of the Murano glass tradition, but because of its North European roots it is a match for the Scandi design style. DutZ glass is distinctive and easily recognizable. DutZ = Dare to be distinct! MORE DUTZ: Need more inspiration? Can't find the DutZ vase you are looking for? Want to see more DutZ Collection glassware? Go and view the full collection here. Contact us for orders. Lowlands Design Ltd is the official distributor of the DutZ Collection in the UK. We supply prestigious florists, retailers, luxury hotels and acclaimed interior designers with our glassware.

## Features

## Information
Step into a space transformed by effortless elegance where lush textures and contemporary design come together to create a striking visual impact. Whether it is an inviting indoor feature wall or a refreshing outdoor retreat, these artificial wall tiles brings your vision to life with its seamless blend of practicality and sophistication. Crafted from 100% polyethylene these artificial wall tile are built for lasting beauty and functionality. Its weather and UV resistant properties ensure it stands up to the elements making it equally suitable for indoor and outdoor use. Whether you are creating a tranquil garden backdrop revitalising a tired fence or adding a modern touch indoors their enduring quality and striking design provide an effortless way to enhance your living spaces.
Measuring 100cm x 100cm, these tiles offer expansive coverage, allowing you to effortlessly create the look of a realistic plant wall. Designed for both impact and practicality, their structured yet flexible form ensures a seamless fit, whether you're enhancing a small feature area or covering an entire surface with vibrant greenery.

The two most important factors we found by talking to our customers were how realistic it looks and how long it lasts.Now you want your beautiful topiary to last. It's a complaint we've heard all too often with other brands of topiary \"My topiary has faded to a blue colour\" or \"My topiary has become brittle and is breaking apart\". So, when we built this range, we made sure we found a solution to this problem. That solution is UV Lock technology.
